Table 7, same own-reimplementation experiment as above (3-layer proj, 2-layer pred, 512-d repr.).

Table 7, row '4096-4096-256 / 4096-256' ('3 layer proj, 2 layer pred, 256-d repr.'): the authors' own evaluation of BYOL under a modified projector/predictor head ('For a fair comparison with BYOL, we also evaluated BYOL with a wider and/or deeper projector head'), so the number was produced by this work rather than quoted from the BYOL paper.
Table 7 baseline row, same own-reimplementation experiment. Differs from Table 1's cited BYOL figure (74.3), confirming this is a rerun by these authors, not a quotation of BYOL's own paper.

The value is real (W-MSE / Ermolov et al. 2020, 'The current W-MSE model achieves 66.3% top-1 accuracy on the Imagenet linear evaluation benchmark', a citation to concurrent work) but it is reported as a top-1 accuracy, not an MSE statistic; no MSE value of 66.3 (or any 'mse' metric) appears anywhere in the paper. Wrong metric for a real value.
